stories.title: Fake FMCSA, DAT, and TIMOCOM Portals Attack US Logistics Firms
stories.description: Cybercriminals impersonate FMCSA, DAT, and TIMOCOM portals via HelloFriends, NodeRemote, and CastleRAT campaigns to breach US trucking and logistics firms.

stories.title: 10-Year-Old NGINX HTTP/2 Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Execute Code on Servers
stories.description: NGINX fixes five CVSS 9.2 flaws, including a decade-old HTTP/2 vulnerability demonstrated to allow unauthenticated code execution.

stories.title: F5 Warns 6 Critical BIG-IP Flaws Can Crash Traffic in Specific Setups, May Allow RCE
stories.description: F5 fixes six critical BIG-IP flaws that allow unauthenticated traffic disruption and may enable code execution in specific configurations.

stories.title: Hackers Use GhostMap eBPF Rootkit to Hide IronWorm Malware From Linux Security Tools
stories.description: Hackers use GhostMap Linux rootkit to hide IronWorm malware processes, files, and network connections from system tools.

stories.title: Hackers Use Hidden Cron Jobs to Reinstall Malware on Firewalls and Routers Every 5 Minutes
stories.description: Evooo1Bot Linux botnet targets network devices, using hidden cron jobs to reinstall malware after removal.

stories.title: Critical Apache Roller RCE Flaw Under Active Exploitation, No Authentication Required
stories.description: Apache Roller CVE-2026-129448 is actively exploited, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution via XML-RPC. Upgrade to 6.1.6.

stories.title: AI Hacking Framework CyberStrikeAI Runs 221 Tool Executions Without Human Approval
stories.description: Exposed CyberStrikeAI workspace logged 221 AI tool executions without human approval, raising concerns over automated security controls.

stories.title: VeroSecurity Raises $11 Million for AI Security Engineering Platform
stories.description: AI Security Engineering is a new and essential security discipline now being brought into focus by VeroSecurity.

stories.title: New EggStreme Malware Variant Goes Silent to Evade Security Tools in Government Attacks
stories.description: EggStreme operators retooled their backdoor with new commands and passive mode while continuing to target Philippine government organizations.

stories.title: Russian APT Poses as Employee of Hacked Firm to Breach Another US Organization
stories.description: Star Blizzard weaponized data and identities stolen in late 2025 to phish and compromise a US organization.

stories.title: Last of Five Defendants Sentenced in US Scattered Spider Hacking Case
stories.description: British national Tyler Robert Buchanan has been sentenced to 6 years in prison in the United States, the DOJ announced.

stories.title: Microsoft Takes Perception Agentic Security Platform Out of Preview
stories.description: Four blue team agents and the Recon Agent are now generally available, while integrations and vulnerability shielding are in preview.
